title: Bit Digital, Inc. Reduces Secured Borrowings from Galaxy Through Partial Sale of ETH Holdings
summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced that it has repaid $50 million of principal under its secured borrowing arrangement with Galaxy Digital. The repayment, funded through a partial sale of the Company’s ETH holdings, lowered outstanding Galaxy borrowings from $100.0 million to $50 million, a reduction of 50%.
body_markdown:
***Company repays $50 million of principal, lowering outstanding Galaxy borrowings to $50 million***


NEW YORK


, Nov. 25, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT) (“Bit Digital” or the “Company”), a publicly listed Strategic Asset Company focused on Ethereum strategies and AI/HPC infrastructure, today announced that it has repaid $50 million of principal under its secured borrowing arrangement with Galaxy Digital LLC (“Galaxy”). The repayment, funded through a partial sale of the Company’s ETH holdings, lowered outstanding Galaxy borrowings from $100 million to $50 million, a reduction of 50%.


The Galaxy facility was originally established to fund Bit Digital’s $100 million bridge financing to WhiteFiber in support of its NC-1 data center development and other growth initiatives. WhiteFiber has recently secured a $300 million project financing facility for NC-1, including a $100 million delayed-draw tranche subject to specified conditions. Bit Digital expects its bridge loan to be fully repaid during the second quarter of 2027. In the interim, the Company is reducing its secured borrowing exposure while retaining its interest in the WhiteFiber bridge loan and maintaining substantial exposure to Ethereum.


“We remain confident in Ethereum’s long-term role in digital finance and in WhiteFiber’s opportunity in AI infrastructure,” said Sam Tabar, Chief Executive Officer of Bit Digital. “By


reducing our Galaxy borrowings, we are lowering secured leverage while retaining meaningful exposure to both assets. We recognize that shareholders expect disciplined execution and tangible results, and our focus remains on making capital allocation decisions that balance long-term opportunity with responsible risk management.”


Between November 15 and 23, 2026, Bit Digital sold 29,825 ETH, generating approximately $50 million in net proceeds and applied the full amount towards repayment of Galaxy principal. The sales were executed at an average price of approximately $1,676 per ETH.


Following the transactions, Bit Digital held approximately 134,532 ETH and ETH-equivalents as of November 23, 2026, including 36,811 ETH natively staked. The remaining $50 million of Galaxy borrowing continues to be collateralized by 69,089 LsETH. Pledged LsETH is included in the Company’s reported ETH-equivalent holdings. Bit Digital’s remaining Ethereum position continues to support its treasury and staking activities.


**About Bit Digital**


Bit Digital (NASDAQ: BTBT) is a Strategic Asset Company (SAC) focused on active participation in Ethereum infrastructure and controlling equity exposure to AI/HPC infrastructure through its majority ownership stake in WhiteFiber (NASDAQ: WYFI). The Company purchases and stakes ETH to generate protocol-native yield and participates directly in the Ethereum network. Bit Digital allocates capital with a focus on long-duration, foundational infrastructure, and disciplined balance sheet management.
